body:
Product seat, 2026-10-31. Priority shift from the operator: Codex will be AIDA's first real user base (Claude is prohibited at their workplace). Linux only for now.

Trigger: with containment on, `aida agent new codex` refuses ("`codex` cannot run an AIDA-contained session"). That's correct per BUG-2144, but it blocks Codex users entirely.

Filed (drafts, high priority, for your disposition):
- EPIC-612: Codex as the primary vendor on Linux, full parity. Children so far below; seat-parity.md's Degraded Codex rows and mail wake still need specs.
- STORY-2238: vendor-neutral containment. AIDA's own bubblewrap sandbox (building on bwrap_confinement_args_inner, STORY-612/617) plus an egress allow-list proxy plus the grant keyring for any vendor, so containment_applied is true for Codex because it meets the bar. Architecture and security: needs a sketch and your signoff. Open sketch questions: nested user namespaces with Codex's own workspace-write sandbox, and the proxy design.
- TASK-2631: this repo's own config contradiction. `[agents] vendor = "codex"` with containment on makes the default vendor unlaunchable, and allowed_hosts has no OpenAI endpoint. The operator chooses the interim fix; doctor should flag the pattern.

Suggested order: TASK-2631 first (small, unblocks today), then the STORY-2238 sketch.
subject: Product: Codex-first priority (EPIC-612, STORY-2238 vendor-neutral containment, TASK-2631 config)
